content.thinking:
My patch script had a syntax error because the test file content contains triple-quote sequences. Let me use a different approach — read the file and use line-based deletion or sed.

I'll use sed to delete the line matching "obs record cname and A coexist ok" and the following line.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
lines = open('tests/test_invalid.py').read().split('\n')
out = []
skip_next = False
for line in lines:
    if "obs record cname and A coexist ok" in line:
        skip_next = True
        continue
    if skip_next:
        skip_next = False
        if 'answer=[rec' in line or 'answer=' in line:
            continue
        # not part of the same statement: keep it
    out.append(line)
open('tests/test_invalid.py', 'w').write('\n'.join(out))
print('\n'.join(out[-12:]))
PYEOF
